title: MGRD: Compact morphology-gated residual diffusion for variance-aware cross-domain neurite forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.23990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tracking neurite morphology over time helps characterize structural changes during neuronal development and deterioration, but long-term time-lapse imaging is resource-intensive and difficult to scale. Forecasting future morphology could reduce this burden. Existing neurite digital-twin models such as gated spatiotemporal attention (gSTA) produce a single deterministic forecast without representing variability among plausible futures. We introduce Morphology-Gated Residual Diffusion (MGRD), a compact stochastic surrogate that jointly forecasts twenty future neurite-morphology frames from ten observed frames while conditioning on morphology features derived from the latest observation. On controlled phase-field trajectories, MGRD reduces trajectory-wise mean MAE by 9.7% relative to a matched control while updating 4.46 times fewer parameters. translated_title: MGRD：用于方差感知跨域神经突预测的紧凑型形态门控残差扩散模型
translated_abstract: 跟踪神经突形态随时间的变化有助于表征神经元发育与退化过程中的结构变化，但长期延时成像资源消耗大且难以规模化，而预测未来形态可以减轻这一负担。现有的神经突数字孪生模型（如门控时空注意力机制 gSTA）只能产生单一的确定性预测，无法表征多种可能未来之间的变异性。我们提出了形态门控残差扩散，这是一种紧凑的随机代理模型，能够从十帧观测图像联合预测二十帧未来的神经突形态，同时以从最新观测中提取的形态特征作为条件。在受控的相场轨迹上，与匹配的对照模型相比，MGRD 将轨迹级平均 MAE 降低了 9.7%，同时更新的参数减少了 4.46 倍。在人类 iPSC 衍生神经元的显微图像上，MGRD 在所有四项报告指标上均优于 gSTA，包括……
tldr: 提出紧凑的形态门控残差扩散模型 MGRD，以最新观测的形态特征为条件，从十帧观测随机预测二十帧未来神经突形态，在参数减少 4.46 倍的情况下于相场模拟和人类 iPSC 神经元显微图像两个跨域场景中均实现更准确且方差感知的形态预测。
en_tdlr: MGRD is a compact morphology-gated residual diffusion model that stochastically forecasts twenty future neurite-morphology frames from ten observations conditioned on latest morphology features, achieving variance-aware cross-domain prediction with 9.7% lower trajectory-wise MAE and 4.46x fewer parameters than deterministic baselines like gSTA.
